utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting Thursday for book club, or did that change?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, we’re still on for Thursday as far as I know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I come?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — if the book club needs anything set up, I’ve got tools I can lend. What are you working on?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I was just thinking about the book club setup, maybe some extra chairs or a table. I can check what we need and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know, and I can help haul chairs or a table over if needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard we’re meeting later this week, and I’m hoping someone picked a really good one this time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think it’s on Thursday, but I’m still checking the time. I just hope someone confirms the place soon so nobody shows up to the wrong house.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Right, the house mix-up would be such a mess. If I hear anything, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — can you tell me where the next book club meeting is being held?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure yet, but I can check and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m putting together a little book club meet-up soon—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Quinn. Please save me a spot if you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Uli—I’ve got you down. I’ll send the details as soon as I pin down the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Leo — I’d be happy to help with the book club. What book are we thinking about this time?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I was thinking we could do a short mystery this month — something easy to get into.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a great idea — a short mystery sounds perfect for the group. Want me to suggest a few titles and see what fits best?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which book club details you mean? I want to make sure I’ve got it right before I say anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Right, sorry — I mean the meeting time and which book we’re reading this week. I usually show up late, so I wanted to make sure I didn’t miss the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course — I just need to check the latest note so I don’t give you the wrong time or title.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around the school pickup time—what day is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s on Thursday evening this week.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday evening should work for me after pickup. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’d love to know what the book club is reading next.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re starting a really lovely mystery next week, and I think you’d enjoy it. If you want, I can bring you the title and meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That would be wonderful, thanks — I’d really appreciate the title and meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, book club—nice, what are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we actually have a pick yet, or are we still deciding?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think we’re still deciding, unless someone already picked one and I missed it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I might come by and listen quietly, if that’s okay.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course, Rey — you’re welcome to just listen quietly. I might forget the snacks, but I won’t forget to save you a seat.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren — I appreciate that. I’ll be there quietly and save room for whatever snacks you do remember.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the book club plan to everyone and see who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll check our supplies and make sure we’re set for everyone who joins.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep everyone posted and see who can make it. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club’s meeting got moved to Thursday. I’ll try to swing by if I finish my errands in time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, Thursday works better for me too. Maybe I’ll see you there if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that’d be great — I’ll do my best to make it after I’m done running around.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I keep meaning to bring something better than my usual cookies. What book are we on again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re on the mystery pick this month— I can remind you of the title, and I’ll probably repeat the plan to bring snacks to the next meeting too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes please, remind me of the title—I’ve already got the snacks in my head twice and the book only once.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the book club. I might’ve missed the latest update; what’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re meeting Thursday at 7 in the community room. I’ll bring the new picks list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo — Thursday at 7 in the community room, got it. I’ll try not to miss this one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand if the book club needs anything. What are we working on?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll bring the books, and we can set the next meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — bring the books, and I’ll help set the time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’d love to help with book club. What are we planning first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh wonderful, Mara! I’m thinking we start by picking the first book and setting a date, then I’ll send out invites to everyone on the block.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds like a great plan — I can help narrow down a first book if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the book club? I’ve been hearing good things—what are you all reading this month?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re reading "The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle" this month—meeting at the community center on Maple Street next Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds great—I’ve heard that one is a wild read. Next Thursday at the community center on Maple Street works well; do you want me to spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’d love to help get the book club rolling. What book are we thinking of starting with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few good options in mind, and I can check what we already have on hand. Want something light and fun, or a bigger discussion pick?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s start with something light and fun so everyone can jump in easily.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the book club’s meeting this week, but I’m still trying to catch up on the details. Did you already pick the next book?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet — I was going to ask you if you had a title in mind.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I don’t have a title yet, but I can ask around and see what people are suggesting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey Faye—book club's still on, right? Just give me the time and place and I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yep — it’s still on. We’re meeting at my place at 7, after the school run, if that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, that works for me — I’ll swing by at 7.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still okay helping with the book club, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, absolutely — I’m still happy to help with the book club.
